state: A character-selection screen from a padel game. Six athlete cards in a two-row grid, each card with a portrait, a name, a role word, a description, a special ability and an availability status. It is the "pick the athlete you play as" picker.

six_cards.instructions: Does this frame show six athlete cards?
six_cards.true: The frame shows six athlete cards
six_cards.false: The frame does not show six athlete cards

bars_read.instructions: Do the stat bars on the athlete cards read the way the design intends - a five-tick bar whose filled ticks are clearly visible in the theme's accent colour, so a player can compare athletes at a glance?
bars_read.true: The bars read as intended: visible, accent-coloured, comparable five-tick bars
bars_read.false: The bars do not read as intended: not visible as accent-coloured comparable bars

clipped.instructions: Is any athlete card clipped or cut off by the edge of the frame?
clipped.true: At least one card is clipped by the frame edge
clipped.false: No card is clipped by the frame edge

defect_class.instructions: Which single defect class best fits the stat-mark row on these cards?

criteria.colour_mismatch: The ink of the marks does not match the colour the theme prescribes for the bar
criteria.glyph_not_rendering: The glyphs the bar is made of do not render, so the bar is invisible or empty
criteria.tick_count_wrong: The number of ticks drawn does not match the number the design calls for
criteria.layout_clipping: The row is coloured correctly but is clipped by the card or the frame
criteria.none: No defect: the row is as the design intends

severity.instructions: How far does this frame deviate from a shippable screen? level 0 = matches, ascending to worst
criteria: Clearly wrong, a player would notice
Broken: the element does not work as a visual element
